_comment: The release audit's calibration (the release-audit skill): defects fixed in beta6 [FIX-01] (Roadmap_Beta6.md), replayed on the tree before their fix to measure what the finders raise unprompted. `wfl audit:calibrate` snapshots each fix's parent and takes the expected lines from the fix's own diff of `files`. A calibration finder reads its snapshot only, never this file.
